cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Win the Smaller Concession
cards.instruction: Get one small surrender, then use its logic to make the larger claim harder to defend.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Can I keep one plant on your windowsill?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Excellent. Sunlight is available to guests. Shall we discuss the other pot?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And you've agreed the principle. Now we're negotiating the size of its audience.

seedUse: Keep a granted small space but ground the wider claim in its stated size limit rather than generic principle.
